select id, company_name, business_license_number, corporate_nature, registration_address, registration_funds, status, resource_locking_status, blacklist, create_time from t_company_info
is_deleted = #{param.is_deleted}
and company_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.companyName}, '%')
and business_license_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.businessLicenseNumber}, '%')
and corporate_nature LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.corporateNature}, '%')
and registration_address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.registrationAddress}, '%')
and registration_funds LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.registrationFunds}, '%')
and status LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.status}, '%')
and resource_locking_status LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.resourceLockingStatus}, '%')
and blacklist LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.blacklist}, '%')
and create_time LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.createTime}, '%')

select id, customer_no, customer_name, login_account, business_license_no, business_license_date, enterprise_nature, registered_address, fname, idnumber, fphone, bank_account, account_number, company_no, company_name, status from t_customer
status = #{param.status} and is_deleted = #{param.is_deleted}
and customer_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.customerNo}, '%')
and customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.customerName}, '%')
and login_account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.loginAccount}, '%')
and business_license_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.businessLicenseNo}, '%')
and business_license_date LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.businessLicenseDate}, '%')
and enterprise_nature LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.enterpriseNature}, '%')
and registered_address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.registeredAddress}, '%')
and fname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.fname}, '%')
and idnumber LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.idnumber}, '%')
and fphone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.fphone}, '%')
and bank_account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.bankAccount}, '%')
and account_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.accountNumber}, '%')
and company_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.companyNo}, '%')
and company_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.companyName}, '%')
ORDER BY ${param.field} ${param.sortType}
